name: @aethelred/noblepay
description: NoblePay — Enterprise Cross-Border Payment Platform with TEE Compliance on Aethelred

scripts.validate: npm run type-check && npm run lint && npm run test
scripts.validate:frontend: npm run type-check && npm run lint && npm run build && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:ci
scripts.validate:backend: cd backend && DATABASE_URL=${DATABASE_URL:-postgresql://localhost:5432/noblepay} npx prisma generate && DATABASE_URL=${DATABASE_URL:-postgresql://localhost:5432/noblepay} npx prisma validate && test -f prisma/migrations/migration_lock.toml && test -f prisma/migrations/20260316_init/migration.sql && echo 'Migration artifacts verified' && npx tsc --noEmit && npx jest --runInBand --forceExit --detectOpenHandles
scripts.validate:contracts: cd contracts && npx hardhat clean && npx hardhat compile && node ../scripts/deploy-devnet-core.mjs --verify-artifacts && node ../scripts/test-deployment-governance.mjs && node ../scripts/test-testnet-token-provisioning.mjs && npx hardhat test
scripts.validate:gateway: cd services/gateway && GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.25.12 go vet ./... && GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.25.12 go test ./... -race -count=1 -timeout 300s && GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.25.12 go run golang.org/x/vuln/cmd/govulncheck@v1.6.0 ./...
scripts.validate:compliance: cd crates/noblepay-compliance && cargo fmt --all -- --check && cargo clippy --locked --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings && cargo test --locked --all-features && cargo test --locked --no-default-features && cargo test --locked --doc --all-features && cargo audit --deny warnings
scripts.validate:dependencies: npm run security:audit && (cd backend && npx --no-install audit-ci --config ../audit-ci.jsonc && npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=moderate) && (cd contracts && npx --no-install audit-ci --config ../audit-ci.jsonc && npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=moderate)
scripts.validate:all: npm run validate:dependencies && npm run validate:frontend && npm run validate:backend && npm run validate:contracts && npm run validate:gateway && npm run validate:compliance && npm run validate:security
